en.headline: Hong Kong Park lights up with giant moon for Mid-Autumn
en.dek: A large illuminated moon installation with hanging planets and star lights is now on display in the Central park each evening, free to visit.
body: Hong Kong Park has installed a space-themed Mid-Autumn display centred on a giant illuminated moon reflected across the water, accompanied by hanging planets and shimmering star lights.
The lights come on each evening from about 6pm. Admission is free. Organisers note that misty or light rain evenings deepen the reflections and enhance the atmosphere.

The park is reachable on foot from Admiralty Station Exit C1 via the Pacific Place escalators in about five minutes, or from Central Station Exit J2 via Garden Road in roughly eight minutes. The display is expected to run through the Mid-Autumn period.

zh.headline: 香港公園中秋巨型月亮裝置亮燈
zh.dek: 中環香港公園現設太空主題中秋裝置，巨型月亮配吊掛行星及星光，每晚約6時起亮燈，免費入場。
body: 香港公園推出中秋太空主題燈光裝置，以巨型發光月亮為核心，映照水面，四周掛有行星及閃爍星光。
燈光每晚約6時起亮起，免費入場。有霧或微雨的晚上，水面倒影更深，氣氛更突出。
市民可由金鐘站C1出口經太古廣場自動電梯步行約5分鐘到達，或由中環站J2出口經花園道步行約8分鐘。裝置預計持續至中秋期間。
